volunteerExperiences.description: On July 28, during the fourth annual Intern Power to Care Day, around 200 NextEra Energy interns and I offered our support to transform U.B Kinsey Elementary School in West Palm Beach . Volunteers constructed a vegetable garden, created murals around the school, painted hallways and buildings, landscaped school grounds and set up classrooms. These projects helped prepare the school for the upcoming year and reinforced NextEra Energy’s commitment to giving back.
